items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1961-01-19
items.q: The interviewee addresses the interviewer as 'Bill' or 'Mr. Bill' throughout the transcript (e.g., 'Well, I don't know if he's living yet, Bill.', 'That's the way I make them people jelp, you know, Mr. Bill.'). There is no mention of a separate person named Bill Bale with whom the interviewee had a

ctx.x: I think he worked in steel mills for the last I knew. He was working, he was a mechanic too, I think, a good machinist. Yeah.
Well, I don't know if he's living yet, Bill.
Work on cars and everything too.
